question: Based on the image of the KitchenAid Artisan stand mixer and the audio description of the Cuisinart stand mixer, calculate the absolute difference in their bowl capacities in liters. Round the final answer to three decimal places.

The wire retail shelving displays several tilt-head stand mixers with stainless-steel bowls and "KitchenAid" badging on the motor heads (Contour Silver, Empire Red, and Black on the top shelf; Pink and White on the middle shelf). Rounded to three decimal places: **0.473 liters**

<answer>0.473 liters</answer>
